messages:
Rae M: Heads-up: starter-kit CI failing on structured tool calls after transient 401s. Validator says "unexpected token at end of JSON".
Priya K: I tracked it down: json-mode helper appends a newline delimiter. Retry middleware then does JSON.stringify again in 401->retry path, producing a quoted string with an escaped newline. Server strict parser chokes.
Samir P: Can you paste the received payload?
Rae M: Received body (as logged): '"{\"tool\":\"search\",\"input\":\"apple\\n\"}"' -> parser sees trailing chars after parse.
Nina L: Yikes. Also signing mismatch: Py signs bytes(json + '\n'), TS signs json without newline. Retry path mutates bytes again -> signature fails intermittently.
Priya K: Proposed fix: in retry.ts, compute payloadToSend = typeof opts.body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(opts.body) ? opts.body : JSON.stringify(opts.body); then sign(Buffer.from(payloadToSend)) and send payloadToSend. Also assert headers['content-type'] startsWith('application/json') before re-serializing.
Samir P: Add tests: unit that compares signature bytes to the Py helper for identical inputs (including newline), and an e2e that stubs auth returning 401 once then 200 to exercise retry. Also add a small test for function-call shape so we don't regress into array-of-quoted-strings.
Priya K: I'll open a small PR tonight. ci-bot: PR #5238 opened by priya-k: "ts: preserve serialized json in retry; sign canonical bytes"  https://ci.redwood/p/5238
Rae M: Thanks. Also please add a blurb to SDK migration guide: "If you use json-mode helpers, middleware must not re-serialize the body; preserve raw bytes for signing and schema parity."
Nina L: Agreed. Once PR passes, run starter-kit CI to ensure flakes are gone. :rocket:
